name: zendesk
description: Zendesk Support integration — search across tickets, users, and organizations, list and inspect tickets with their comment threads, look up users, search Help Center articles, and create or update tickets and comments. Uses OAuth2 client-credentials auth against a confidential OAuth client in your Zendesk Admin Center (a short-lived access token is minted fresh on every invocation); API-token basic auth is not used because Zendesk is sunsetting API tokens starting 2026-07-28.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Zendesk Support tickets, users, and Help Center via OAuth2 client credentials

fields.label: Zendesk Subdomain
fields.patternMessage: Just the subdomain (e.g. yourcompany for yourcompany.zendesk.com), not the full URL
fields.helpText: The subdomain of your Zendesk instance — the part before .zendesk.com.

fields.label: OAuth Client ID (unique identifier)
fields.helpText: The unique identifier of a confidential OAuth client created in Admin Center under Apps and integrations > APIs > OAuth clients.

fields.label: OAuth Client Secret
fields.helpText: The secret shown when the OAuth client is created. Zendesk shows it only once — copy it then.

tools.name: zendesk.search
tools.description: Search across tickets, users, and organizations using Zendesk's universal search query syntax (e.g. "type:ticket status:open priority:high").

query.description: Search query in Zendesk search syntax (e.g. "type:ticket status:open login error")

tools.name: zendesk.list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets, optionally filtered by status and sorted. Returns a trimmed summary per ticket.

status.description: Only return tickets with this status

sortBy.description: Field to sort by (default created_at). Sorting by id is only supported without a status filter; with a status filter it falls back to created_at.

tools.name: zendesk.get_ticket
tools.description: Get a ticket's details plus its comment thread (author, public/internal flag, and body per comment).

tools.name: zendesk.search_help_center
tools.description: Search Help Center (Zendesk Guide) knowledge-base articles by keyword.

query.description: Keywords to search article titles and bodies for

tools.name: zendesk.get_user
tools.description: Look up a Zendesk user by id, or search users by email address. Provide userId or email.

email.description: Email address to search users by (used when userId is not given)

tools.name: zendesk.create_ticket
tools.description: Create a new support ticket with a subject and first comment, optionally setting the requester, priority, and tags.

body.description: Body of the ticket's first comment (the description)

requesterId.description: Existing user id to set as requester (takes precedence over requesterEmail)

requesterEmail.description: Requester email — creates the user if they don't exist yet

tags.description: Tags to set on the ticket

tools.name: zendesk.update_ticket
tools.description: Update a ticket's status, priority, assignee, and/or tags. Note that tags replace the ticket's existing tag list.

assigneeId.description: User id of the agent to assign the ticket to

tags.description: New full tag list (replaces existing tags)

tools.name: zendesk.add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket, either public (visible to the requester) or internal (agents only).

ticketId.description: The ticket id to comment on

public.description: true for a public reply visible to the requester, false for an internal note (default true)
